items.label: Ultimate Leakproof Protection
items.value: Made of extra-thick 3 mm food-grade silicone, this under-sink mat delivers superior waterproof protection for your cabinets, shelves, and floors. Its raised 1.6 cm edge securely contains up to 3 gallons of liquid—effectively shielding against plumbing leaks, stains, and chemical spills before they cause damage.

items.label: Perfect Fit for Every Cabinet
items.value: Available in 15 precise sizes, our silicone sink liners are engineered to fit most standard kitchen and bathroom cabinets. The flexible edge lies completely flat without curling, and the soft, pliable silicone seamlessly conforms around pipes, corners, and irregular surfaces for a clean, built-in appearance.

items: Premium Silicone Material：Unlike flimsy plastic, our heavy-duty silicone mat is odorless, tear-resistant, and long-lasting. It offers dual-sided anti-slip: the textured bottom grips wet cabinet surfaces firmly, while the interior pattern keeps bottles and cleaners from sliding. Made from 100% food-grade silicone, it’s heat-resistant, oxidation-resistant, and won’t yellow or crack over time.

Effortless Cleaning & Installation： No tools needed—just unroll and place. The one-piece molded design eliminates seams where grime can hide, making it exceptionally hygienic. Thanks to its raised wave-textured surface, water drains efficiently after washing dishes or wiping spills, and the smooth silicone allows for quick cleanup—simply wipe or rinse, and it’s spotless again.

Versatile Home Organizer： Beyond under-sink protection, this waterproof silicone tray shines in countless roles: as a dishwashing mat / drying rack liner, drawer liner, desk protector, washer/dryer anti-vibration pad, printer or office equipment mat, boot tray, pet feeding mat, coffee bar mat, plant saucer, and even a doormat alternative—perfect for capturing dirt, moisture, and debris right at your entryway. Ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, laundry rooms, garages, offices, and more.
